note: Names that hash to a referenced value but are collision debris: block-byte harvest names (aset_block_strings.json) with an identifier's shape, ones the production table (production_names.json) took in before the harvest was filtered, and rainbow-table names that matched an animation-table cell by chance. Every reader of the harvest, --pack-data's read of the production table, and tools/build_production_names.py drop these (hash, name) pairs. Each hash is pandemic_hash_m2 of its name.
